The console is wrapped in clear plastic film on the top and sides.
The rear ports are visible, including a USB port, an HDMI port, an Ethernet port, and a power port.
The console is sitting on a granite-like countertop.
A watermark 'GADGET WORLD' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' is visible across the center of the image.
